limitations: Floating point solvers, not unrestricted exact rational proof systems.
Final compiled algebraic coefficients must fit binary64 exactly; 21/64 characterized ordinary decimal products now explicitly refuse instead of silently rounding.
Two-component intermediate polynomial capacity; third components explicitly reject.
Coefficient-part division must be exact: x/3 explicitly rejects; (3*x)/3 and dyadic quotients remain accepted. This bounded compiler is not an arbitrary rational algebra system.
Folded transcendental constants retain floating arithmetic semantics; AST and regrouped polynomial candidates need original-expression verification.
Finite differences remain approximations; no proof of a derivative from finitely many black-box probes.
Known highly conditioned cancellation LPs may honestly reject; they are not included among matrix successes.
Tighter conic internal stopping may require more iterations within unchanged user resource caps.

finite_matrix.counting_rule: Count unique explicit parameters/query tuples or dataset/query tuples. Duplicate Beta(1,1), repeated fatigue-life parameters and coalesced affine queries are deduplicated. A loop case is not called a Rust unit test. Different units (run specs, output columns and step tuples) are reported separately.

independent_oracles: Elementary power/exponential/logistic CDFs and independently arranged log-density laws over scale1e-100..1e100, shapes0.25..10, positive and negative locations.
Small binomial/hypergeometric direct combinations; Poisson/negative-binomial/geometric/logarithmic PMF recurrences and independent finite-prefix CDF sums.
Original atoms are transformed by mul_add, then independently enumerated and coalesced to derive exact pushforward CDF/PMF; no inverse-coordinate assumption.

Fixed Gaussian probability constants plus analytic change-of-variable Jacobians for Normal, Lognormal, JohnsonSU/SB/SL, FatigueLife, Levy and symmetric SkewNormal; arbitrary noninteger tails are checked by the parent's separately qualified SciPy probe.

Independent histogram/cumulative piecewise masses, uniform empirical quantile interpolation, duplicate-knot atoms, two-term Metalog logistic/loglogistic/uniform reductions and conditional uniform laws.
Expected shortfall identity ES=eta+E[(L-eta)+]/(1-alpha) at an independently selected empirical alpha quantile.
All nine process recurrences independently replayed with supplied shocks, mixed-sign offsets and units1e-100,1,1e100; conditional standard deviations checked separately.
MC/LHS/Sobol retained columns recomputed by independent two-pass statistics; exact LHS strata and power-of-two Sobol prefix strata; retained/streaming bitwise moment agreement.
Scaled normal MLE and Bernoulli likelihood/AIC direct algebra.
confirmed_repairs: Weighted categorical Q(1) preserves the last positive-mass endpoint even when its cumulative increment rounds away.
Rounded affine discrete CDFs and PMFs use exact finite-f64 preimages and stable original interval masses, including atoms that coalesce under a huge offset.
Normal/Lognormal CDFs use the existing directly evaluated regularized-gamma tail, removing amplified legacy error in accepted tail truncations.
Gamma/Erlang/ChiSquared upper quantiles invert direct gamma-Q survival; Beta upper quantiles invert the swapped lower tail; symmetric negative affine quantiles avoid forming1-p.
Hyperbolic-secant median returns its exact location, preserving a small location under huge scale.
Inverse-Gaussian upper quantiles invert survival directly; Mills' ratio uses a bounded128-level Laplace continued fraction instead of a five-term asymptotic series.

Continuous truncation uses an exact atom-free lower bound. Gaussian interval probabilities use a positive8-node Gauss-Legendre integral for small widths and direct-tail differences otherwise, preserving probabilities adjacent to a truncation bound. Inclusive discrete/hybrid atoms remain explicit.
limits: The matrix is finite and does not establish all-f64 or vendor-wide numerical parity.
Only independently qualified external reference operations count; unreliable near-one SciPy PPF/CDF and ambiguous discrete inverse boundaries are not accepted as sole oracles.
Generic count interval masses have bounded exact summation and stable probability-tail evaluation; unsupported numerical ranges return structured errors.
Metalog matrix reductions use two terms; existing separate global-certificate and higher-order basis/moment tests remain required.
Time-series innovations are externally replayed deterministic values; this verifies recurrence algebra rather than stationarity of every possible stochastic parameterization.
Fixed confidence intervals retain their stated Gaussian/CLT assumptions, adaptive intervals require true deterministic bounds, and Sobol/LHS points are not treated as independent units.
Likelihood fitting remains a bounded local search where documented; these tests do not create global MLE or optimality guarantees.

counting_rule: Native totals count Rust test bodies; matrices count declared configurations/route/query tuples inside those bodies. Do not add these different units. Correct infeasibility, forgeries and precision refusals are identified separately.
